title: Damage Charts
description:
Damage analytics and an incoming-damage forecast for Slay the Spire 2.

- Incoming forecast, docked beside your character: the HP you're about to lose this turn and what you'll be left at (a range when uncertain). Counts enemy intents (including final death blows), damage over time, self-damage cards and powers, Block, Osty and end-of-turn Block (Plating, Orichalcum, Cloak Clasp, Ripple Basin, Frost orbs), and ignores enemies that will die to Poison first. Shows your spare Block when you're safe and how much HP Osty is about to lose. A thin HP bar previews the loss. Reads Safe when nothing can hurt you; hover it for the per-round history and itemized sources.
- Damage Out | In / Round: a small always-on chart above the forecast, dealt vs taken for recent rounds.
- Combat stats (default C): damage dealt and taken by source, a per-round chart (hover a round or fight for its breakdown), potions used and a scrollable combat log.
- End-of-combat summary beside the rewards list, and a run recap out of combat.
- Uses the game's own fonts, icons and frames; optional big-moment effects with the game's own VFX.

Single-player and multiplayer. Standalone, depends on no other mod. Damage from powers, relics and potions (Poison, Thorns, Fire Potion, ...) is credited by name, not just as Status.

Source code, issues and the full config reference: [url=https://github.com/brian-gates/sts2-damage-charts]github.com/brian-gates/sts2-damage-charts[/url]
changeNote: 1.3.1: the map and other game screens (deck view, card selection) now open over the damage chart and forecast instead of underneath them. Game tooltips still draw on top of both.
